offering_description.value: Franchises and operates high-volume, low-price gyms branded as Planet Fitness, offering membership access to cardio and strength equipment in a casual atmosphere. Revenue comes mainly from franchisees' royalties and fees, plus equipment sales to franchisees and some company-owned clubs.

primary_products.value: fitness equipment sold to franchisees; branded merchandise

primary_services.value: gym memberships; franchising; franchise support and marketing

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual gym members, mostly casual and first-time gym users; B2B: franchisees who open and operate clubs

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: franchise royalties and fees from franchisee-operated clubs, plus national advertising fund contributions; product sales: fitness equipment sold to franchisees for new and re-equipped clubs; subscription: monthly membership dues at company-owned clubs
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; product sales; subscription

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns the Planet Fitness brand and licenses it to franchisees; asset operator: operates company-owned gyms serving members; distributor: supplies purchased equipment to franchisees

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Dominican Republic, Panama, Mexico, Australia, Spain

specialization.value: related lines: franchising, company-owned clubs and equipment sales, all within the budget gym business

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned clubs; partners / resellers: franchisee-operated clubs; online: online membership sign-up and app

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: franchise disclosure rules (FTC), consumer membership contract and auto-renewal laws, health and safety rules
